name: SVG Bundle Preflight
summary: Batch-check a ZIP of SVG cut files for documented import blockers, duplicate content, and filename collisions before release.
customer: Solo Etsy or Gumroad sellers who create and maintain original English-market Cricut-compatible SVG bundles containing roughly 20 to 500 cut files per release.
problem: A large SVG bundle can contain live text, clipping paths, gradients, raster content, scripts, external references, duplicate files, or colliding paths that are difficult to catch with one-file-at-a-time release checks.
solution: A downloadable offline browser utility that inventories one ZIP or a direct SVG selection, applies deterministic compatibility and bundle-hygiene rules locally, hashes exact content, and exports CSV and self-contained HTML evidence reports.

acceptance_checks.description: A deterministic nested fixture ZIP inventories exactly four valid SVG files and produces zero compatibility blockers.
Malformed XML, live text, clipping paths, gradients or patterns, external images, embedded bitmaps, scripts, and missing sizing metadata report the expected path, check ID, and severity.
Exact duplicate SVG bytes and case-insensitive path collisions form one correct group each without grouping distinct files.
CSV and self-contained HTML reports include bundle metadata, totals, every path, check ID, severity, and evidence without modifying input files.
The packaged utility scans fixtures from file:// with the network disabled, uses bundled assets only, makes no outbound request, and creates no persistent browser storage.
Unsafe paths, invalid UTF-8, damaged or encrypted archives, unsupported selections, and file, archive, count, and expansion limits fail safely with customer-facing messages.
The versioned release ZIP is deterministic, contains only intended buyer assets and dependency notices, enforces restrictive CSP, and includes no source maps or development files.
The product pull request passes manifest validation plus clean-install unit, release, and Chromium offline-browser checks on GitHub Actions.
